fields.System.Title: INB-203 — Capture batch and expiry for tracked products
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to record the batch and expiry on arrival, so that FEFO
works and a recall can find the stock later.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a batch-tracked product, then a batch number must be captured before the line is
  • complete.
  • - Given an expiry-tracked product, then an expiry date must be captured.
  • - Given a batch label barcode, then scanning it populates the field — typing is a
  • fallback, not the default.
  • - Given a typed batch number, then it is validated against the configured format.
  • - Given one delivery containing two batches of a product, then they can be recorded as
  • two lines.
  • - Given an expiry date in the past, then it is rejected.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory |
| Tables | receipt_line, batch |
| Risks | Typo in a typed batch breaks FEFO ([doc 05 WF 1](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
